selection: First numbered section of each of the eight source patients, fixed before reading expression values. No serial section is a separate patient. All patients included.
optional_S2_250: not run; redundant with mandatory and secondary panels

model_mapping.E0: Frozen C4 primary D1 MLP three-seed ensemble (C5 B1)
model_mapping.E1: C5 validation-selected B2a/B2b by parent panel/regime
model_mapping.E2: C5 B3 with exact frozen interpolation and lambda
model_mapping.E3: Secondary C5 B4 primary ResNet18 frozen heads, restricted independently by gene; same PCA and kNN6/cap250 graph

sampling_contract: Nested random permutation or deterministic greedy farthest-point XY selection, start farthest from eligible centroid, ties first frozen row; exact floor(N*b+.5). No expression in sampling.
V1: All tissue eligible; score every unobserved location; policy changes scoring membership.
V2: Three geometry centers at 25/50/75 percent of PC1 coordinate rank (PC1 sign first coordinate positive); nearest 40% locations form fixed unavailable region per center, tie by row; sample only outside. Score same unavailable locations at every budget/policy; all other unobserved labels hidden too.

preprocessing.counts: Assert finite nonnegative integer published UMI counts. log1p then exact C0 training gene mean/SD, by gene identifier. No external centering, library-size scaling, imputation, area correction, or fit.
preprocessing.images: 112 um nominal square using coordinate-calibrated mpp, rounded native pixel width, centered nearest integer top-left, LANCZOS resize 224 RGB, exact C0 official ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1 preprocessing.
preprocessing.coordinates: Supplied H&E pixel centers; mpp inferred from documented 200 um array pitch and least-squares pixel vs refined array coordinate mapping. Barcode join checked.
preprocessing.platform_shift: Sequencing ST 100 um diameter capture spots, 200 um pitch, versus developmental Xenium transcripts pooled in 100 um squares. Counts are both per-location nonnegative integers with the same frozen log-count model interface; capture efficiency/area/depth differs. This is a cross-platform zero-shot test, not a same-assay calibration claim.
preprocessing.source_QC: Published selected spots and gene columns inherit source filtering. Shared intersection frozen using gene headers only. Upstream tissue/gene filtering is not refit here.

pass_criteria.unit: patient; masks/seeds averaged within patient/budget/regime/policy before patient summaries
pass_criteria.meaningful_E2_over_E0: delta median Pearson >=0.02 AND relative mean MSE reduction >=0.02
pass_criteria.meaningful_E2_over_E1: delta median Pearson >=0.01 AND relative mean MSE reduction >=0.01
pass_criteria.primary: S2-50 common 40-gene intersection; V1 random is primary, regular and V2 separately reported
pass_criteria.pass: At least 6/8 patients show meaningful E2>E0 at >=2/3 V1-random budgets, and >=4/8 show meaningful E2>E1 at >=1 budget; positive median patient gains over both; <=25% V1-random settings with E2 MSE > E1 by >2%; >=6/8 patients have E2 Pearson(40%)>Pearson(10%) and MSE(40%)<MSE(10%); distance behavior characterized, V2 honestly reported, all audits pass.
pass_criteria.limited: Same interpolation criteria but external evidence limited by assay, panel, patient count, or non-replicating contiguous regime; report qualification/domain limitations explicitly.
pass_criteria.mixed: Does not pass; at least 2 patients meet meaningful E2>E0 at one V1-random budget or E2>E1 at one; otherwise FAIL_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.
pass_criteria.technical: Any corrupted hidden-label dependence, replay mismatch, parent hash change, noninteger/incompatible target representation, or identity failure => FAIL_TECHNICAL.
pass_criteria.V2_support: Report separately: >=4/8 patients show E2>E0 meaningful at >=1 random budget and >=4/8 E2>E1 at >=1 budget. Does not rescue failed V1.

C7C: not run; independent breast cohort already tests platform shift as primary
